subject: Tickets 38, 42, 47, 52: the low-severity runtime tier
description:
Restored to the punch list 2026-08-20 after being dropped in summarisation.

38 - fallback_kind is re-derived by substring-matching the program's own prose. Arnon (A9): "no prose-parsing should be present in the code base. Should be fixed." This is the campaign's founding defect - the incident where a decision was rendered to prose, the structured result thrown away, and the sub-command breakdown later re-derived by regex over that prose: 813 of 975 compound-allow decisions under-logged, 1,943 sub-commands with no record. Same family as ticket 32 item 1 (four LockUnavailable reasons collapse to one, then a false message is announced from what survives).

42 - normalize_entry returns (None, error) and SEVEN call sites discard the error. Silent failure.

47 - TakeoverConfig's 4th positional field is no_match_fallback, so the stock positional construction misassigns it.

52 - a wrong-typed [[permissions]] section is discarded with no signal - no parse failure, no warning. TOML, so unaffected by the JSON retirement under TOO-67.
